projects.name: Mazaq
projects.description: A complete go-to-market strategy for Mazaq — from market and competitor analysis to a 3-month content and Meta Ads plan — built as the final project for a digital marketing diploma.
strategyPoints: Full brand audit: market & category, digital environment, competitor & SWOT analysis
Positioned Mazaq as "the instant hot beverage that turns everyday moments into cozy, enjoyable experiences"
Buyer personas built around "the digital youth" and "comfort seekers"
SMART objectives and KPIs mapped across a 3-month horizon

projects.name: Okhtein
projects.description: A 30-day social campaign concept to close Okhtein's TikTok gap and strengthen its lower-funnel conversion path, built around the brand's heritage-luxury story.
strategyPoints: Five-pillar content system rooted in heritage, craft, and founder story
14-day content calendar with caption direction per pillar
Phased Meta Ads funnel — Awareness → Consideration → Conversion — on a simulated $1,000 budget
Two buyer personas across Cairo and Gulf-based customers

projects.name: Noon
projects.description: A 30-day full-funnel social and Meta Ads strategy designed to grow Noon's paid-social sales from near-zero to 350+ monthly orders on a 5,000 EGP budget.
strategyPoints: Five content pillars: Product Spotlight, Trend & Culture, Social Proof & UGC, Offers, Community
Three-stage Meta Ads funnel — Awareness → Consideration → Conversion — with retargeting
SWOT and competitor analysis against Jumia Egypt and Zoodmall
